segments.note: air: the market street reads in a second; out at 1.25 so the fireball is on screen before the third second, as the brief asks; picture 07b3: a still wide of the street with walkers, read at 1.1 s, kept short on purpose for the three-second fireball
Meera looks up, the fireball, the rattling glass, her parents' wave, her wave, the dust wall, her face in the dust: each short shot is one step of the impact, all whole

join: c2 opens behind Meera on the thinning dust, a new angle on the empty stalls and not a repeat of c1's dust wall, both kept; her line and the rattling shutter whole; air: her walk along the shopfront has read by 7.0; picture 424e: one step of her walk in profile, 1.46 s is the step, the next shot is her close
the close on her eyes ends the bazaar
air: the still maize and the post read in a second and a half
Yash through the maize, the boy at the post, his line, Yash's walk to him, all whole; air: the wide on the post is still after 13.5

Yash's arm comes up and the light wipes the picture: the flash is the cut point; out at 17.3 on the near-white frame, before the roar's last burst at 17.5-17.8, so the cut does not chop it; picture 9e15: the boy shielding his face as the light washes out, 1.3 s to near white is the whole beat
join: a scene change out of the white-out, entered through the flash; the road's first second is still, so the pickup's approach is kept to 1.6 s
the cab, the streak, the brake, the ditch, the jolt, Suman slumped: short shots, all whole so the crash stays clear

join: c5 opened on c4's last frame again, starts after the repeat at 0.167; the truck in the ditch from outside is a new angle with the dust settled, not the crash again, kept; Suman's line whole; air: the boy's look up has read by 14.25; join: the 0.21 s sliver of Devendra climbing out at 14.54 is cut on its shot change
air: Devendra's look past the boy has read by 2.0
the trail, the craft, Devendra, the open hatch, Suman's look: the reveal, whole
join: c7 opens from the craft's side looking back at the three, a new angle; air: nothing moves after 1.7

join: Devendra's close is the shot of his line, not c6's look again, entered 0.6 s before the word; Suman, the boy's two hands, her look down, his look up and her face held whole: the episode ends on her face
